text_en: The oracle that the prophet Habakkuk saw.
text_cn: 哈巴谷先知在神视中所得的神谕。

text_en: O Lord , how long shall I cry for help, and you will not listen? Or cry to you “Violence! ” and you will not save?
text_cn: 上主，我呼救而你不予垂听，要到何时？向你呼喊“残暴”，而你仍不施救？

text_en: Why do you make me see wrongdoing and look at trouble? Destruction and violence are before me; strife and contention arise.
text_cn: 为什么你使我见到邪恶，人受压迫，而你竟坐视？在我面前，只有迫害和残暴，争吵不休，辩论迭起。

text_en: So the law becomes slack and justice never prevails. The wicked surround the righteous— therefore judgment comes forth perverted.
text_cn: 为此法律松弛，正义不彰，恶人包围了义人，因而产生歪曲的审判。

text_en: Look at the nations, and see! Be astonished! Be astounded! For a work is being done in your days that you would not believe if you were told.
text_cn: 你们应观察列邦，且应注视，你们必要诧异惊奇，因在你们的日子内，我要做一件事，纵然有人述说，你们也不相信。

text_en: For I am rousing the Chaldeans, that fierce and impetuous nation, who march through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.
text_cn: 看，我要激起加色丁人──那残忍凶猛的民族，向广大的地区进发，侵占别人的居所。

text_en: Dread and fearsome are they; their justice and dignity proceed from themselves.
text_cn: 这民族独断独行，目中无人，实在令人恐怖。

text_en: Their horses are swifter than leopards, more menacing than wolves at dusk; their horses charge. Their horsemen come from far away; they fly like an eagle swift to devour.
text_cn: 他们的马捷于虎豹，猛于夜狼；他们的马队由远方飞腾而来，像扑食的老鹰；

text_en: They all come for violence, with faces pressing forward; they gather captives like sand.
text_cn: 大事摧残，面目焦燥，有如烈风；聚集的俘虏，多似尘沙。

text_en: At kings they scoff, and of rulers they make sport. They laugh at every fortress, and heap up earth to take it.
text_cn: 他们嘲笑列王，讥讽诸侯，嗤笑任何堡垒，只堆一堆土，即可攻下；

text_en: Then they sweep by like the wind; they transgress and become guilty; their own might is their god!
text_cn: 然后鼓起勇气向前猛进，以自己的力量为神。

text_en: Are you not from of old, O Lord my God, my Holy One? You shall not die. O Lord , you have marked them for judgment; and you, O Rock, have established them for punishment.
text_cn: 上主，你自古不就是我的天主，我的圣者？你决不会死亡！上主，你派他们来是为执行审判；磐石，你立定他们是为施行惩罚。

text_en: Your eyes are too pure to behold evil, and you cannot look on wrongdoing; why do you look on the treacherous, and are silent when the wicked swallow those more righteous than they?
text_cn: 你的眼睛这样纯洁，以致见不得邪恶，见不得折磨！你为什么垂顾背信的人？当恶人吞噬较他更义的人时，你又为什么缄默？

text_en: You have made people like the fish of the sea, like crawling things that have no ruler.
text_cn: 你竟把人当作海里的鱼，当作没有主宰的爬虫！

text_en: The enemy brings all of them up with a hook; he drags them out with his net, he gathers them in his seine; so he rejoices and exults.
text_cn: 他们把所有的一切用勾子勾上来，用网拉上来，用罟（gǔ）收集起来， 为此欢欣踊跃，

text_en: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and makes offerings to his seine; for by them his portion is lavish, and his food is rich.
text_cn: 向网献祭，向罟（gǔ）焚香，因为给他们带来了富裕的财物，丰美的饮食。

text_en: Is he then to keep on emptying his net, and destroying nations without mercy?
text_cn: 难道因此他们就应时常倒空自己的网，无情地屠杀万民？
